## Overview

This template separates:
- pipeline scripts in `R/`
- manuscript in `manuscript/`
- generated outputs in `output/`

To rebuild everything, run:

```r
source("R/00_run_all.R")
```

## Data

```{r}
dat <- readRDS("../data/derived/data_clean.rds")
head(dat)
```

```{r}
fit <- readRDS("../output/checkpoints/model.rds")
summary(fit)
```
